camera.evidence: phase-correlation shift of wall region vs frame 0 < 0.01 px for all frames; mean abs diff of untouched regions f0 vs f44 < 1.1 grey levels
camera.perspective_cues: Inside view of a block-wall warehouse corner. Blue roller conveyor ramp runs from upper-left (~x 255, y 535) down to lower-right where it meets a wooden floor/pallet (~x 1420-1920, y 985-1080). Ramp far (upper) edge has image slope ~0.58 (30.3 deg below horizontal; points (700,539),(1300,889)); near (lower) edge slope ~0.66 (33.4 deg; points (300,620),(1000,~1080)); edges diverge toward lower-right, so the ramp descends roughly toward the camera. Wall faces camera nearly frontally (horizontal mortar lines). No horizon visible. Focal length unknown.

objects.name: box
objects.description: Rectangular case, black sides with a green lid/top, labels 'D5', a red light on the top front. The ONLY moving object.
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the filled (convex-hull) silhouette; approximates the projected rigid-body centre (origin)
objects.apparent_size_change: long-axis length 335 px (frames 0-8, falling, level) -> ~340-346 px (frames 14-28) -> ~352-364 px (frames 34-44): grows ~9% overall, i.e. box ends ~8% closer to camera than at start (if size taken as proxy of 1/depth). Width across grows more because of tilt (top face becomes visible).
